display: Newtown jazz guitarist and teacher who plays in a few bands, tours around Australia, and has a Superhost spare room on Airbnb.

signals.text: I'm looking for someone reliable in Newtown or the inner west who can do Airbnb changeovers at short notice while I'm on tour.
I'm away on a Melbourne tour from Thursday 8 October, and the spare room will sit empty while I'm gone.
I need a venue and a PA for a student recital on 14 November. Church halls in Enmore are my first choice.
I'm finishing my debut album with Monday Ghosts. Mixing is in October, mastering in November, and I'll press 300 vinyl in Melbourne.
The album budget is $14,000 and I've raised about $9,500, so I'm still short on the pressing costs.
One bad cleanliness review could cost me Superhost status. The hosting income pays a big part of my rent, so I need the room's quality to stay dependable.
Money is tight. If my rating slips I'll have to find about $450 a month from somewhere.
I can't be home on tour weekends, so I'd like a way to check the room's condition remotely or have someone check it for me.
I want to build up my weekly teaching income and get more adult beginners, because those lessons are the part of my work I love most.
I'm tired of playing wedding gigs just to cover rent and would like more paid work that is actual jazz.
I want to improve how I protect myself on loud gigs, and I'd like to hear from other touring musicians about what works.
I find it hard to explain playing behind the beat on purpose to people who weren't in the room, so I'd like to talk it through with a listener or writer.

offers.text: I'm a jazz guitarist with ten years of gigging in Sydney and Melbourne and a Berklee online diploma. I can play sessions, support slots and live gigs.
I teach guitar to twelve students a week from my front room in Newtown at $60 an hour, from nine-year-olds to people in their sixties, including adult beginners.
I own a 1978 Ibanez semi-hollow and a Gibson ES-175 reissue, both in good order, and can bring either to a session.
I run a wedding and event quartet and can play a five-hour set with a mix of standards and requests.
My Newtown spare room has a queen bed, a shared ensuite and a 4.9-star Superhost listing. It suits visiting musicians or touring acts, and it's free when I'm not touring.
I share a 2012 Toyota HiAce with my bassist for touring, and I know the Melbourne, Adelaide and Byron gig circuits.
I'm part-way through self-funding a debut album: crowdfunding, a Marrickville studio, and vinyl pressing in Melbourne. I can share what I've learned about each step.
I have experience running a recital for students of mixed ages and abilities, and I can coach nervous first-time performers.

catchers.hypo: Hi, I'm a bass player visiting Sydney for a few weeks and need a cheap place to stay near the Newtown gig scene. Do you know anyone with a room?
catchers.can: I can offer my spare room on the nights I'm away, or point them to local venues and musicians.
catchers.confirm: Are you a touring or visiting musician who needs a short stay in Sydney's inner west?

catchers.hypo: I'm 40 and have wanted to play guitar since I was a teenager. I've never had a lesson. Is it too late to start?
catchers.can: I can offer a first lesson with a simple song and a practice plan for adult beginners.
catchers.confirm: Are you an adult with little or no guitar experience who wants regular weekly lessons in Newtown?

catchers.hypo: We run a small church hall in Enmore and have a free Saturday in November. Would a student recital work for you?
catchers.can: I can hold the recital there on 14 November, bring the students and their families, and bring or arrange a PA.
catchers.confirm: Is your hall in or near Enmore, available in mid-November, and able to seat around 40 to 60 people?

catchers.hypo: I run a small PA hire business in the inner west. Does anyone you know need gear for a community event?
catchers.can: I can hire a PA for my student recital and recommend you to other musicians I work with.
catchers.confirm: Can you supply a PA and a sound person for a small hall in Sydney's inner west in November?

catchers.hypo: I'm a bassist looking for a trio to play originals. I like jazz that sits behind the beat. Do you know of anyone?
catchers.can: I can introduce them to Tom, my bassist, who has played with me for ten years, or recommend other players in the Sydney jazz scene.
catchers.confirm: Do you play jazz bass or drums and want to work on original material rather than standards?

catchers.hypo: I do short-notice cleaning and laundry for Airbnb hosts in Newtown and Marrickville and have openings in October. Do you need anyone?
catchers.can: I'd book you for the weeks I'm on tour and for the changeovers I need covered.
catchers.confirm: Are you in the inner west, available on a few days' notice, and able to supply references from other hosts?

catchers.hypo: I've started a small pressing run for my own record. Can you tell me about vinyl plants in Melbourne?
catchers.can: I can share what I've found about pressing costs, lead times and artwork requirements.
catchers.confirm: Are you a self-funded artist planning a short vinyl run of a few hundred copies?

catchers.hypo: I've been on the road for years and my ears are suffering. What do other musicians do to keep playing?
catchers.can: I can talk through my own experience with moulded earplugs and the advice I've been given.
catchers.confirm: Are you a working musician asking about hearing protection on stage?

catchers.hypo: I'm a Superhost with a small spare room and I'm worried about a bad review. How do I protect my rating?
catchers.can: I can swap notes on changeover routines and cleaning checklists.
catchers.confirm: Are you a small Airbnb host in Sydney, dealing with cleaning consistency while you're away?

forbids.text: I won't take Sunday wedding gigs after October.
I'm not available to check the room in person on tour weekends.
I won't change the listing price during tour weeks.
I don't take on cleaning or changeover help that can't give reliable short-notice cover.
I won't share my health details or anything about my past relationships.

projects.name: Monday Ghosts debut album
projects.text: A ten-song original jazz trio album recorded in Marrickville, with six tracks done. Mixing is in October, mastering in November, and vinyl pressing in Melbourne.

projects.name: Student recital
projects.text: A recital on 14 November for students aged 9 to 61, with parents and friends in the audience. It needs a venue in Enmore and a PA.

policy.t1: I'll share my tour dates, when the room is empty, and that I need reliable short-notice cleaning while away.
policy.t2: Once trust is established, I'll talk about the Superhost review risk and how much the rent depends on the hosting income.
policy.never: I won't share details about my ex-partner or any health records.
